name: Kindr
tagline: The coordination layer for enterprise elder-care programs.
positioning: Kindr keeps care teams, families, and case managers on the same care plan — so no medication, appointment, or handoff falls through the cracks.

hero.h1: Every caregiver, family, and case manager on one care plan.
hero.sub: Kindr turns scattered phone calls, spreadsheets, and sticky notes into a live coordination hub for enterprise elder-care programs — from intake to escalation.

features.title: One living care plan
features.description: Medications, appointments, dietary needs, and standing orders in a single record every stakeholder can see — with a full audit trail of who changed what and when.

features.title: Handoffs that don't drop
features.description: Shift changes, hospital discharges, and caregiver swaps trigger structured handoff notes, so the next person on shift walks in already caught up.

features.title: Family kept in the loop
features.description: Adult children get plain-language updates and a shared calendar instead of frantic 9pm phone calls — cutting inbound calls to your care line by half.

features.title: Escalations before crises
features.description: Missed check-ins, skipped meds, and rising fall-risk scores surface to case managers automatically, with a clear next action attached.

features.title: Coverage you can prove
features.description: Export shift coverage, visit verification, and consent records for payers and auditors without rebuilding the report by hand each quarter.

features.title: Fits your existing stack
features.description: Two-way sync with your EHR, scheduling, and claims systems so Kindr becomes the coordination layer, not another silo to reconcile.

testimonials.quote: Before Kindr our case managers spent mornings reconstructing what happened overnight. Now the handoff note is already there. We reassigned two FTEs to actual care instead of chasing updates.
testimonials.name: Dolores Amsberry

testimonials.quote: Family complaint calls used to swamp our line every Monday. With shared updates and the visit calendar, those calls dropped by half in one quarter. The families finally feel included.
testimonials.name: Raymond Okafor

testimonials.quote: Audit prep used to take a week of pulling records from four systems. Kindr exports coverage and consent in an afternoon. Our payer reviews stopped being a fire drill.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman
